label: caller-thread pipeline producer
hypothesis: Prepare each one-layer group on the calling CPU thread before its consumer, retaining copy-stream overlap with previously queued GPU work. Avoid worker dispatch, separate thread CUDA context and main/producer handshakes. A0001 b1 profile spends 10.55 ms summed CPU ticket acquisition; b8 baseline 92.8 ms. These overlaps are not additive, so measure end-to-end.
change: Replace background producer submission with per-group inline production, keeping identical gather, copy stream, buffer slots, events, group size and arithmetic. No A0002 byte-copy or A0003 grouping changes.

not_run.frozen_baseline_confirmation: Only if incremental parent gain passes
not_run.full_validation: Only after confirmation against parent and frozen baseline

tradeoffs: CPU gather can now delay compute submission; per-group stream context switching may cost more than worker coordination.
Host/GPU slot capacities and all lookup/transfer bytes remain unchanged.
decision: Promising screen b1 prefill incremental offload/gap reduction; candidate producer diagnostic supports lower coordination overhead. Require independent parent comparison.
